remarks: Spectacular sun sets and great view with this lot. Look for sign on property marked lot #6. This lot is 1760 feet Above Sea Level. Has access to Western New York County Snow mobile trails in Winter. You can park in the driveway that is just (left) South of the lot if you want to get out and walk around. Corners are marked with red flagged stakes. Check out survey located in pictures. Property taxes are unknown as this parcel is being split off a large parcel and will be assessed by town after sale and transfer of deed.
